name: application-trip-summary-card
title: Trip Summary Card
description: Drive summary card with a title/timestamp header, a route line, and a 2x2 grid of trip stats (distance, duration, average speed, efficiency).
useWhen: Summarizing a completed drive or trip in a navigation, EV, or fleet app.
You want distance, duration, average speed, and efficiency together in one glanceable card.
The trip has a clear origin/destination worth naming in a route line.
avoidWhen: You need a live, in-progress trip view rather than a post-trip summary — build a dedicated active-navigation UI instead.
There are more than 4 stats to show — extend the grid to 3 columns or link to a full trip detail page rather than cramming more cells in.
Efficiency doesn't apply (e.g. non-EV) — swap that cell for a more relevant stat like fuel cost or CO2 saved.
responsiveBehavior: The card is a fixed max-w-sm block whose 2-column stat grid fills the available width up to that cap at all breakpoints.
accessibility: Each stat pairs a value with its unit as adjacent, always-visible text, avoiding ambiguous bare numbers.
The route line uses a full text arrow ('Oak Street → Riverside Tech Campus'), not an icon-only representation of direction.
Timestamp and title are both plain text in the header, keeping trip identity scannable without extra context.

variants.title: Trip summary card
variants.description: 'Morning commute' trip with a route line and a 2x2 grid: Distance, Duration, Avg speed, Efficiency.
accessibility: Stat cells use a shared light background to visually group them as a set, separate from the header text.
